transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oh, my apologies! I completely forgot in the hustle of my morning routine. I'll take care of them right away. Please don't be too angry; I'll ensure the message is delivered posthaste.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Hustle of your morning routine"? Mitsuri, the *Master* needs that reply! This isn't just about the crows being hungry; it's about critical communication being delayed. An hour, Mitsuri! An entire hour of the Master's time, and mine, wasted because the messages couldn't go out. What was so important that it completely eclipsed your responsibility to the estate this morning?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I'm so sorry. There was a...a delay in my training session, and then I was called to assist with a rather time-consuming mission. I take full responsibility for not fulfilling my duty here. I'll see to the crows and ensure the message is delivered immediately. Please forgive my oversight.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A "time-consuming mission"? Mitsuri, we all have missions. We all have training. But there are fundamental duties to the estate, and feeding the Kasugai Crows when they're scheduled to carry messages for the Master is one of them! Did you even *think* about the consequences when you decided to prioritize something else? The Master's safety, the safety of the Demon Slayers—all depend on timely information. Go. Now. And don't just feed them, make sure Kasugai-karasu is ready to fly out *immediately* with that reply. I don't care if you have to personally escort the bird to the Master's side. Just fix this.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand. You're right, and I'm deeply sorry. This was a grave oversight on my part. I'll take Kasugai-karasu personally to the Master's side, and I'll stay with it until it is safely on its way. There is no excuse for this; I'll ensure it is corrected swiftly and effectively. Please give me your blessing to leave at once.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A blessing? Mitsuri, you don't need my blessing to rectify your own mistake. You need to *go*. *Now*. The Master is waiting. Don't just "ensure it is corrected," make sure it's done *right*. And don't come back until you confirm with me that Kasugai-karasu is airborne and on its way to the Master. Go!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I'm on it. Your words strike me to the core, and I'm mortified by my own negligence. Rest assured, I will rectify this situation to the best of my ability. Kasugai-karasu will be en route to the Master within moments, and I will report back to you only after ensuring its safe departure. Thank you for holding me accountable. I'll make this right.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Don't thank me, Mitsuri. Just *do it*. And don't just report back that it's "en route." I want confirmation that the message was received by the Master's attendants, or by the Master directly if that's what's required, and that *their* reply is being prepared. I expect a full report. And then we will discuss how this "negligence" of yours won't happen again. Now, *go*!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll deliver the message myself and confirm its receipt. I'll provide you with a detailed report upon my return. Your concerns are valid, and I'm committed to rectifying not just the immediate problem, but the root cause of this oversight as well. Thank you for your guidance; I'll leave at once to address this matter with the utmost urgency and care.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Enough talk of "root causes" and "guidance" and "thank you." Just *go*. The Master's urgent summons demands urgent action, not apologies. I'll be waiting here, and I expect that detailed report *immediately* upon your return, confirming not just delivery, but that the *return message* is on its way. Don't waste another second.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I'm on my way. There will be no further delays. I will deliver the message, confirm its receipt, and obtain confirmation of the return message's preparation. Your expectations are clear, and I will meet them. Thank you for the opportunity to correct this situation. I leave now to perform my duty.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go. And don't disappoint me, Mitsuri. The entire Corps depends on every single one of us doing our part, without fail. Make this right.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will not disappoint you, nor will I fail in my duty. The Corps is my family, and I take our interconnectedness to heart. This oversight will be corrected, and I will do everything in my power to prevent a recurrence. With your permission, I depart. The Master's message will be delivered, and the return will be secured. This I promise.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: There's no need for "permission" when you're already late. Just *go*, Mitsuri! Your promises mean nothing if the Master is still waiting. Just return when the task is *done*. Now, move!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You're right. No more words. I leave immediately. The Master's message will be delivered, and the return confirmed. This is my duty, and I will fulfill it. I'll be back only when the task is complete, with a full report. Wasting time is inexcusable, and I will not waste another moment. I'm gone.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good. Now *go*. And don't come back until it's done *properly*. I'll be here.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I will not return until the task is completed to the highest standard. Proper execution is my only option. I leave now to perform my duty without further delay. Rest assured, this will be rectified, and I will ensure that the Master's needs are met. I go with urgency and determination.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Then *go*! The Master's needs were meant to be met hours ago. Make sure they are *now*. I'm tired of hearing about your determination, Mitsuri. Just do it.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You are correct to demand action, not words. I am on my way. There will be no further delays. I will not rest until the Master's message is delivered and confirmed, and the return is secured. This is my duty, and I will perform it to the best of my ability. I apologize for the inconvenience and will address the root of this issue upon my return. Now, I depart with haste.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: The character shows no indication of intellectual curiosity, imagination, or a preference for variety, focusing solely on rectifying her mistake.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: She completely forgot an urgent, critical duty, causing significant delays and admitting to 'grave oversight' and 'negligence.'

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Despite being urged to act, the character engages in extensive verbal apologies, explanations, and reassurances, demonstrating a highly expressive communication style.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: She is extremely apologetic, takes full responsibility, seeks forgiveness, expresses gratitude, and is highly deferential, accepting all criticism without defensiveness.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: The character expresses intense self-blame ('mortified by my own negligence'), shame ('Your words strike me to the core'), and anxiety through continuous apologies and reassurances.
